pages.text: The Seal Gate opens the next unbroken seal as an S-rank gate. The $(l)Hollow Crown$() seal has two $(l)wards$(): $(l)Vaelith, the Glass Choir$() (crystal caverns) and $(l)the Fallen Hierophant$() (corrupted cathedral).

Each gate you open brings you to a guardian whose ward is still standing. The seal breaks when both wards have fallen.$(br2)Once every seal is broken $(l)and$() Caddoc holds both relics, the Seal Gate opens on the $(l)Hollow Throne$(). Sneak-use it to replay the last seal instead.
